name: Fourth Milling Company
summary: Fourth Milling Company engages in the production of flour, feed, bran, and wheat derivatives in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company packs and mills wheat, maize, barley, flour, meal, and bulgur wheat, as well as rice, dried leguminous vegetables, and edible nuts; oats production; production of flour from rice; manufacture of flour and dough for bakeries, breakfast grain food in flakes, popcorn, starch from corn and potatoes; and corn milling.
